method: softmax average of 2 independently seeded runs of the v2 recipe, each with hflip TTA; binary decision threshold tuned on the validation split only

screening_operating_point.selected_on: validation split, lowest threshold meeting >=0.90 sensitivity
screening_operating_point.note: Screening trades specificity for sensitivity on purpose: a missed referable case is worse than a false alarm. Use this operating point for triage, the accuracy-optimal one for benchmark comparison.

test_split: full official MedMNIST test split (never subsampled, never tuned on)
